name: Kourou ELA-4
tagline: Ariane 6's home pad — Europe's geostationary access after Ariane 5
description: The sister pad to ELA-3 at the Centre Spatial Guyanais. Construction started in 2015; Ariane 6's maiden flight VA262 lifted from here on July 9, 2024. ELA-4 inherits the same 5.2°N equatorial advantage that made Ariane 5 the most successful Western geostationary launcher of its era, with a redesigned ground-segment for higher cadence: horizontal-integration assembly building, sliding mobile gantry, full integration of the new ESC-B upper stage. Europe's strategic-autonomy launcher for institutional payloads (Galileo upgrade, Copernicus, ESA science missions) plus commercial GEO traffic.
best_known_for: Ariane 6's home pad — Europe's geostationary access after Ariane 5
